description: Search Pinterest pins by keyword (any language) for visual inspiration. Returns title, description, full-size image_url with width/height, dominant colour, source website, board and save count for each pin; video pins also get video_url (MP4) and video_seconds. Pins whose largest image is under 500px wide are marked low_res: true; skip them when you need a full-size reference. Set media to "video" for motion/interaction references. Promoted pins are filtered out. Use next_bookmark to page further. Tips: English keywords usually return more results; add words like "ui", "app", "dribbble", "poster", "moodboard" to steer the style.

bookmark.description: Pass next_bookmark from a previous call to get the next page

limit.description: How many pins to return (1-100, default 20)

media.description: Only return video pins ("video"), only still images ("image"), or both (default)

previews.description: Also attach small thumbnails of the first N pins so you can actually look at them (0-16, default 0). Use this when judging visual style, layout or colour matters.

name: pinterest_search
title: Search Pinterest
